jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer – AMD/Xilinx RFSoC
jobs.description: Embedded Software Engineer - AMD/Xilinx RFSoC - Netline Communication Technologies Embedded Software Engineer – AMD/Xilinx RFSoC Job Description: TNG is seeking an experienced Embedded Software Engineer to join a team of top-tier professionals developing a high-performance system built on the AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoC platform. This system will form the core technology behind the company’s future RF and wireless products, spanning secure cellular communications, signal-emission detection, and protection against communications exploitation. Responsibilities include: Develop embedded C/C++ software for the RFSoC’s Arm Cortex-A53 and Cortex-R5F processors in embedded Linux, FreeRTOS, and bare-metal environments. Configure RF ADC/RF-DAC resources, AXI and DMA data paths, interrupts, clocks, NCOs, interpolation, decimation, and multi-tile synchronization. Support RFSoC board bring-up, FPGA integration, debugging, and system validation. Implement detection infrastructure and embedded algorithms to identify anomalous or unauthorized activity. Develop and optimize end-to-end, high-performance PCIe/DMA software solutions across embedded and host platforms, including low-level Linux drivers, user-space components, APIs, libraries, multithreaded applications, and automated performance testing. Job Requirements: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Strong embedded and system-level development experience in C and C++. Experience with Linux kernel development, device drivers, kernel modules, and user-space hardware interfaces. Experience with PCI Express, and DMA-based data transfer. Practical knowledge of AMD/Xilinx XDMA IP and Linux XDMA drivers. Experience developing multithreaded applications on Ubuntu or another Linux distribution. Experience with AMD/Xilinx Zynq, MPSoC, or RFSoC platforms and tools such as Vitis, Vivado, and PetaLinux. Knowledge of AXI, DMA, DDR, interrupts, memory mapping, cache coherency, and buffer management. Experience designing APIs and interfaces between kernel drivers, user-space libraries, and applications. Understanding ADC/DAC operation, sampling, I/Q processing, NCOs, interpolation, decimation, and FFT analysis. Strong debugging and performance-analysis skills using JTAG, GDB, ILA, kernel logs, tracing, and profiling tools. Ability to apply oscilloscope and spectrum analyzer. Ability to work closely with FPGA, RF, DSP, hardware, and system engineering teams. Knowledge of LTE / 5G Cellular technology is major advantage. Key Advantages Unified protection against drone and RC-IED threats. Real-time threat detection and adaptive response. Detection while jamming capabilities. Counter IED Portable Counter Drone Solution Duo-Guard Manpack Counter-Drone & Counter-IED Manpack Full-Spectrum Protection for Modern Threats Modern operational environments expose dismounted forces to increasingly complex threats, from radio-controlled IEDs to hostile drones operating across multiple communication layers. The Duo-Guard Manpack provides a unified, mission-ready solution by seamlessly integrating Netline’s proven Counter-IED and Counter-Drone technologies into one compact backpack system. Designed for operations up to 6GHz, it delivers reliable protection while preserving mobility and flexibility in dynamic field conditions. Supports 3 Main Operating Modes: Counter-Drone Reactive Protection – The system continuously scans the spectrum for drone threats and applies reactive jamming to neutralize them. Counter RC-IED Protection – Ultra-fast reactive protection against IED threats , ensuring continuous safeguarding of personnel while on the move. Combined Mode – Ultra-fast reactive protection against IED threats combined with active drone jamming – delivering comprehensive defense that safeguards the force in the field. Flexibility & Adaptability across Operational Scenarios Leveraging advanced Software Defined Radio (SDR) architecture, the system delivers real-time detection and neutralization of threats across a wide frequency range of 20MHz to 6GHz – ensuring flexibility across operational scenarios, environments, and emerging threats, providing maximum protection. The flexible, SDR-based hardware keeps the Duo-Guard Manpack current and adaptable to any environment through programming, customization, and upgrades tailored to mission requirements. Simultaneous UAS Detection & Jamming Duo-Guard delivers continuous spectrum coverage, constantly scanning to detect analog, digital, and ELRS/Crossfire-based drone transmissions while analyzing their communication patterns in real time. Upon detection, the system immediately notifies the operator and supports either automatic engagement or an operator-authorized response. Leveraging Netline’s reactive technology, Duo-Guard performs rapid look-through reception during jamming, enabling simultaneous threat detection and disruption without compromising situational awareness or the ability to identify additional new threats. The system then dynamically tailors its countermeasures to the detected signal, effectively disrupting control links, video, telemetry, and GNSS while preserving operational continuity on the move. Duo-Guard Manpack Main Benefits: Single backpack unit, combining UAS & IED protection. Continuous wideband coverage up to 6GHz. Counter IED Portable Counter Drone Solution Counter-Drone System A Comprehensive Counter-Drone System Some RF analysers use sensors to detect radio communications between drones and their controllers, identifying the drone’s presence. However, in spectrally saturated environments like urban areas, detecting unauthorized drone communication can be challenging. Thus, a more sophisticated and precise solution is required. Advanced counter-drone technology is essential to defend against modern drone threats, ranging from intelligence gathering to armed attacks. Netline’s anti-drone systems can detect drones and track their flight paths. The DroneNet counter-drone solutions provide full protection by jamming the communication between the drone and its controller, effectively disabling the drone and eliminating the potential threat. The Need for a Better Anti-Drone System A revolution in warfare has occurred with the increased use of drones. The number of adversaries using inexpensive, off-the-shelf, and DIY drones has surged, creating significant security threats worldwide. These drones can attack military bases, VIP convoys, or civilians, causing massive damage and loss of life without proper counter-drone systems. Drones pose an asymmetrical threat to frontline forces, exposing them to attacks from the air. Their widespread availability allows any individual or group to acquire and adapt them for malicious purposes, including DIY drone attacks. Additionally, drones’ intelligence-gathering capabilities represent a major security threat. Protection from drones requires a holistic, multi layered, and comprehensive counter-drone defense system. The DroneNet System Drone Protection Counter Drone The DroneNet: A Multi-Layered Counter-Drone System Defense and police forces, as well as other at-risk entities, need efficient and effective drone protection measures. Netline’s multi-layered counter-drone defense systems, the DroneNet product line, are designed to eliminate drone threats in all weather conditions. These systems form a protective shield around the forces, preventing drones from penetrating the covered area. Netline’s multi-layered anti-drone systems provide a holistic solution for electronic warfare drone protection. These layers can be customized according to operational requirements. Our solutions create a virtual protective dome that isolates and prevents unauthorized drones from intruding into critical airspace, disabling them in real time. Our powerful anti-drone protection uses three defense measures: drone detection, drone tracking, and drone jamming. Netline's systems include a mission control system that can be operated from a central command room, even remotely. Counter IED Portable Counter Drone Solution Counter IED SYSTEMS The Need for High-Tech Counter IED Systems Our counter IED system can help reduce the threat posed by remote control improvised explosive devices (IEDs). The United Nations (UN) reports that hundreds of IED attacks occur every month around the world. IED attacks are a global issue. They are used in Africa, the Americas, Asia and Europe, resulting in the loss of thousands of lives . IEDs are used particularly by rogue individuals and non-state armed groups. This is why IED countermeasures, such as Netline’s C-Guard IED jamming technology, have become so important. IED countermeasures can help combat the destruction caused by terrorist groups and others using IEDs. They play an important role in saving lives, preventing injuries, and reducing societal disruption. The Growing Demand for Counter IED Protection An IED is an explosive device that can be fabricated easily, at a relatively low cost. An IED can take any form and suit any operational environment and is often used for single, targeted attacks. These self-made bombs are connected to common wireless radio frequency (RF) receivers, such as a two-way radio, mobile phone, pager, remote control and so forth. Remote controlled devices like these, enable terrorists to operate as a single-person, individual terrorist cell without depending on a well-prepared, intelligence-based terror infrastructure. IEDs are generally made from non-military components and are usually employed by non-state armed groups and resistance movements, mostly in asymmetric warfare. The fact that they are cheap and, relatively speaking, easy to manufacture means that they have increasingly been used as lethal tools of destruction, societal disruption, and terror in recent years. These kinds of attacks traditionally target concentrations of state forces or civilians. IED attacks currently occur globally on a scale of hundreds of incidents per month, according to data from the UN, resulting in tens of thousands of casualties and an untold amount of destruction and disruption. The use of IEDs has become so common that AOAV (Action On Armed Violence) reports that IEDs cause more civilian deaths and injuries than ground-launched and air-launched attacks combined. The C-Guard Family – Counter IED Technology Capabilities Netline specialises in electronic warfare systems. We provide a comprehensive, effective method for remotely preventing the detonation of IEDs. Netline’s C-Guard Family provides complete C-IED systems with full spectral coverage and reactive jamming technology. Our products create a virtual “protective dome” that shields the force by preventing remote detonation of IEDs within the protected area. and tactical objectives. Special forces are trained to execute unconventional operations by air, land, or sea during missions in the enemy’s territory. The designated activities of SF units are unconventional warfare, Direct Action, Information Operations (i.e., EW operations), Counterterrorism, Special Reconnaissance, Foreign Internal Defense, Civil Affairs and more. Special Forces employ a variety of tactics, sophisticated technology, and rigorously trained teams. EW countermeasures play a pivotal role in special operations activities (mainly in the military arena) providing tactical self-protection for the ground forces. The main challenge is to provide frontline forces with technological edge over the enemy and maximum security on enemy-controlled areas during direct-actions operations. The equipment used by SF units must be ultra- powerful, small & easily carried, and being ready to operate “on-call”. Military systems must present the highest level of performance, without any compromise on the robustness of the system, which is required to withstand harsh environmental conditions often characterizing SO. As such, SO equipment requires constant innovation to tackle the ever-emerging threats. Specializing in EW systems, Netline offers a comprehensive approach for securing ground forces by providing the force in action a virtual “protective dome”, denied of any unwanted communication (RC-IEDs, Drones, Cellular Communication, etc.). Netline offers a complete line of jamming systems with a variety of solutions suited to the ever-changing operational environments, meeting the strictest military standards (MIL STD).
